title.zh: Bitcoin Policy Institute质疑MSCI排除比特币储备公司的指数规则
title.en: Bitcoin Policy Institute质疑MSCI排除比特币储备公司的指数规则

current_state.zh: The Bitcoin Policy Institute published a report questioning MSCI's proposed index rules that could exclude digital-asset treasury companies like Strategy and Metaplanet, arguing the rulemaking process lacks transparency given the index provider's ~$21 trillion in tracked assets.
